issues.claim: Section 1 impact high end: "about 135–315 staff hours ... at $72/hour ... = about $9,700–$22,600 a year"
issues.problem: Arithmetic slip at the top end, non-material and on the conservative side: 315 hours x $72 = $22,680 (would round to ~$22,700), not $22,600. The low end checks out (135 x $72 = $9,720 ~ $9,700), and the $72/$9,700/$22,600 chain is internally consistent everywhere else.
issues.fix: Change "$22,600" to "$22,700" (or state the hourly rate as $72.20 and give $9,700–$22,800).

issues.claim: Section 1 and email: posting "asks for QCS/RMS alongside Word, Excel and Outlook"
issues.problem: Overstates one requirement. The careers page lists Word/Excel/Outlook (and Office/Project) as expected or required, but QCS/RMS familiarity is described as "a BIG PLUS", i.e. preferred, not required. Grouping them in one parallel list implies equal weight.
issues.fix: Reword: "...asks for Word, Excel and Outlook, with QCS/RMS familiarity a plus." Same fix in the email line.

issues.claim: Section 1 and email: "your QC manager signs each" / "with your QC manager signing each one"
issues.problem: Presumes a QC Manager is currently in post. The audit's own evidence is that the firm is publicly recruiting that role, and the audit does not establish whether one is employed today (it later says "whoever runs QC"). Presented as fact rather than inference.
issues.fix: Hedge: "whoever signs off QC at your end (your QC Manager, or the PM until that role is filled)".

issues.claim: Section 1 pilot: "measured against your QC manager's."
issues.problem: Dangling possessive - measured against the QC manager's what? Reads as an editing slip in a document that will be read by an operations audience.
issues.fix: Complete it: "measured against your QC manager's own drafts of the same documents."

issues.claim: Section 3: "weekly certified payrolls through NJ Wage Hub" cited to https://www.nj.gov/labor/wageandhour/prevailing-rates/njwagehub.shtml
issues.problem: The cited page supports the online-submission duty (P.L. 2023, c.138) but does not state the weekly filing frequency. The weekly element is correct, but it comes from a different NJDOL page (the Wage Hub FAQ says "four ways to submit weekly certified payroll"). Source/claim mismatch only.
issues.fix: Add the FAQ URL (https://www.nj.gov/labor/wageandhour/prevailing-rates/wagehubfaq.shtml) to the sources, or drop "weekly" from this line and keep it in Section 3's body only if sourced.

issues.problem: Accurate but unidentified. There is no such figure on the company's own careers page, so a founder reading this may not know which listing is meant and could read it as the careers-page posting being misquoted.
issues.fix: Name the source of the figure: "...and a separate Quality Control Manager listing of yours advertising $100,000–$140,000."

issues.claim: Section 2: "at $48/hour (cost estimator median, NJ, x1.25 for benefits, our assumption)"
issues.problem: Arithmetically right but easy to misread - the NJ cost estimator median is $38.74/hour ($80,570/yr), so the parenthetical can look as though $48 is the median. Same pattern in Section 3 ($36 vs $29.21 median, correctly inflated).
issues.fix: Show the base: "$38.74/hour NJ median x 1.25 = $48/hour, our assumption" (and "$29.21 x 1.25 = $36/hour").

issues.claim: Section 2: "You hold an Air Force MACC IDIQ" (cited to IDIQ FA448420D0005)
issues.problem: True, but the cited vehicle's ordering period closed 2025-03-18. The same FPDS feed shows Benaka's later MACC IDIQ FA448425D0009 (last date to order 2032-03-11), which is what actually supports the present tense.
issues.fix: Cite or mention FA448425D0009 alongside FA448420D0005 so the present-tense "hold" is evidenced.
